notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
